column1: # Every character other than a letter or digit that occurs in a word (W) or morpheme (M) FORM
# of NTUFormosanCorpus, by language (xml:lang), and what strip_word_punctuation.py does with it.
# action: delete = punctuation, removed (ruling 2026-10-18: "Punctuation shouldn't be in W FORMs
#   or M FORMs anyway. Delete everywhere in NTU."); keep = a letter of the language's orthography
#   or a morpheme-structure marker; final = punctuation removed only from the end of a FORM (strip_word_punctuation.py:
#   final_run_start), kept inside a word; hold = not clear that it is punctuation here, left in place
#   until the maintainer rules. A character missing from this table stops the build.

column6: letter: glottal stop in this language's Ortho94 and Ortho113 tables (Orthographies/Ortho94, Ortho113)
